Flood Statement
National Weather Service Lake Charles LA
921 PM CDT Mon Oct 12 2026

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Louisiana...

  Calcasieu River near White Oak Park affecting Calcasieu Parish.

...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Louisiana...

  Calcasieu River Near Salt Water Barrier affecting Calcasieu Parish.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Texas...

  Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Jasper,
  Orange, Hardin and Jefferson Counties.

For the Calcasieu River...including Glenmora, Oakdale, Oberlin,
Kinder, White Oak Park, Salt Water Barrier...Minor flooding is
forecast.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

921 PM CDT Mon Oct 12 2026

...FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL THURSDAY AFTERNOON...

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Calcasieu River near White Oak Park.

* WHEN...Until Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 2.0 feet, Minor flooding of Goos Ferry Road will
  occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
  - At 8:05 PM CDT Monday the stage was 1.4 feet.
  - Forecast...The river will oscillate around flood stage with a
    maximum value of 2.0 feet early Wednesday morning.
  - Flood stage is 2.0 feet.
  - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
